name: Form
purpose: Provide a finished native submission boundary and consistent form rhythm while Atom owns submission and validation behavior.
useWhen: Related controls submit user input as one operation.

avoidWhen.condition: Controls are unrelated immediate settings or actions.

composition: Compose Form -> Field for each independently labelled control -> a named submit Button; add Fieldset only when multiple controls answer one meaningful group question.

rules.statement: Keep native submission available and give submitted controls names.
Load styles.css or core.css plus form.css and every rendered child component stylesheet.

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating Form as a complete login or contact workflow.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep business workflow in the application or a future Block; Form owns the generic visual boundary.

commonMistakes.mistake: Wrapping the entire form in Fieldset only to obtain spacing, then repeating the page heading as its legend.
commonMistakes.correction: Let Form own ordinary field rhythm and reserve Fieldset for a real labelled subgroup.

validation: Inspect submitted values, invalid relationships, spacing, and narrow-layout behavior.
